question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 16 hours, pipe B can fill the same tank in 21 hours and pipe C can fill the same tank in 11 hours. The time taken by them to fill the same tank if they operate together is::
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills the tank in 16 hours

Pipe B fills the tank in 21 hours

Pipe C fills the tank in 11 hours

**Formula Used:**

1-day work = 1 ÷ Time

Total time = 1 ÷ (Sum of individual rates)

**Calculation:**

⇒ A’s rate = 1/16

⇒ B’s rate = 1/21

⇒ C’s rate = 1/11

⇒ Combined rate = 1/16 + 1/21 + 1/11

⇒ LCM(16, 21, 11) = 3696

⇒ Convert each:

1/16 = 231/3696

1/21 = 176/3696

1/11 = 336/3696

⇒ Combined rate = (231 + 176 + 336) / 3696

⇒ Combined rate = 743 / 3696

⇒ Total time = 3696 ÷ 743

⇒ Total time =4(724)/(743) hours

**∴ They will fill the tank together in approximately 4(724)/(743) hours.**
